We have template 2895 with retro_smarts_template: '[C:7]-[#8:6]-[c:5]1:[c:4]:[c:3]:[c:2](-[NH2;D1;+0:1]):[c:9]:[c:8]:1>>O=[N+;H0;D3:1](-[O-])-[c:2]1:[c:3]:[c:4]:[c:5](-[#8:6]-[C:7]):[c:8]:[c:9]:1'

So forward reaction: product is nitro aryl? Actually forward: O=[N+...]... product is nitro aromatic with O-? Wait mapping: left side (reactants) is nitro group attached to aromatic? Actually the SMILES: O=[N+;H0;D3:1](-[O-])-[c:2]1:[c:3]:[c:4]:[c:5](-[#8:6]-[C:7]):[c:8]:[c:9]:1 >> right side (product) is [C:7]-[#8:6]-[c:5]1... So the template is a retrosynthetic transformation: breaking a C-O bond linking an alkyl (C:7) to an O (6) attached to aromatic carbon (c:5). The product is the aromatic with O-alkyl substituent; the precursors are nitro group attached to aromatic (nitro aryl) and an alkyl alcohol? Wait retro: product (target) is [C:7]-[#8:6]-[c:5]... i.e., an aryl-oxygen-alkyl (aryl-O-alkyl). The precursors are nitro aryl (O=[N+]... attached to aromatic) and the alkyl carbon (C:7). Actually the retro template: product -> precursors: product is aryl-O-alkyl; precursors: nitro aryl (nitro group attached to same aromatic carbon) and alkyl carbon (C:7). So applying this template to a target molecule will generate two precursors: a nitro aryl (same aromatic core with nitro group) and an alkyl fragment (the carbon attached to O). The target molecule is given in earlier input: from make_8_lvl1-apply_template-1 answer: ['CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc(N)cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1', 'O=S(=O)(Cl)c1ccccc1F'] Wait that's the precursors for some earlier step. But the current task: "return all possible precursors of applying the template as the result of the task make_8_lvl1-template_search-2 to the molecule below". The "molecule below" is not explicitly given in the prompt now. Possibly the molecule is the product of previous step? The earlier input from make_8_lvl1-apply_template-1 gave precursors for some target. That target is likely the product of applying template 2895 to something? Actually make_8_lvl1-apply_template-1 asked: "Can you return all possible precursors of applying the template as the result of the task make_8_lvl1-template_search-1 to the molecule below?" and answer gave two SMILES list: ['CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc(N)cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1', 'O=S(=O)(Cl)c1ccccc1F'] So that was applying some template (maybe different) to a molecule (not shown). Now current task: "return all possible precursors of applying the template as the result of the task make_8_lvl1-template_search-2 to the molecule below". The molecule below is not shown in the prompt; maybe it's the same as earlier? Could be the product of template 2895? We need to apply template 2895 to a given molecule. But we don't have the molecule SMILES. Maybe the molecule is the product of previous step? The previous step's answer gave two SMILES (precursors). The product of that step would be something else. However we have the mapped_rxn in template: shows product side (right side) is the aryl-O-alkyl. The product SMILES maybe is the combination of the two precursors? Actually the product is the aryl-O-alkyl. The precursors are nitro aryl and alkyl carbon (maybe as a fragment). So to get precursors, we need to apply template to a target molecule (the product). The target molecule likely is the one from make_8_lvl1-template_search-2. That task asked for mapped_rxn associated with template 2895. So the target molecule is the product side of that mapped reaction? The mapped_rxn string shows reactants >> products. In mapped_rxn, left side is reactants (nitro aryl + alkyl fragment) and right side is product (the aryl-O-alkyl). So the product SMILES is the right side of the mapped_rxn. Let's extract it: after >> we have '[CH3:1][C:2]([CH3:3])([CH3:4])[O:5][C:6](=[O:7])[N:8]1[CH2:9][CH2:10][N:11]([c:12]2[cH:13][c:14]([NH2:15])[cH:16][c:17]3[c:18]2[O:19][C:20]2([CH2:21][CH2:22][CH2:23]2)[CH2:24][CH2:25]3)[CH2:26][CH2:27]1'

That is the product SMILES. So the target molecule is that SMILES. We need to apply template 2895 to that molecule to get precursors. Use apply_template tool.


Let's call apply_template with molecule_smiles = that product SMILES, template_id = "2895".
